title: Editorial Portfolio Chapters
concept: Socalco, a fictional wine cooperative of sixty-three terrace growers: a near-black frame around an abstract terraced-hillside campaign hero, four vintages told as colour-fielded magazine-cover chapters, the cooperative's story only after the wine, oversized service disclosures, and a vermilion harvest-booking finale.
notes: Hero and the N.º 9 label are original inline SVG; other photos are Unsplash, saved locally. Vanilla IntersectionObserver reveals (720ms media masks, 55ms staggers), header tone follows section boundaries, services are button disclosures with Escape + focus return. Reduced motion renders everything static.
